summary: The customer called technical support frustrated because his new router was not connecting to his mobile devices via Wi-Fi. The agent verified the connection, guided him through a router restart and factory reset, and then performed a backend profile configuration. The issue was resolved, and the customer was able to access the internet.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، بعتذر منك عن الإزعاج.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite and calm demeanor throughout the call, even when the customer was frustrated and agitated.

evidence.text: بعتذر منك مرة تانية سيدي، أنا عارف إنها تجربة مزعجة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and validated his poor experience appropriately.
The agent successfully diagnosed the profile issue and resolved the internet access problem by the end of the call.

evidence.text: هسا افتح الـ Wi-Fi settings عـ موبايلك، دور عـ شبكتنا، ودخل الـ password الجديدة الموجودة عـ الاستيكر
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The instructions provided by the agent were clear and easy for the customer to follow step-by-step.

evidence.text: في أي شي تاني بقدر أساعدك فيه اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly checked for additional assistance and closed the call politely, though he referred to himself as a woman in the very last Arabic sentence ('ومشكورة اتصالتك' which is a minor slip).

evidence.text: تمام سيدي، هيك الـ Wi-Fi اشتغل تمام والمشكلة صارت عنا بالـ profile تبع الـ line. دقيقة وحدة بس خليني أعملك configuration من عندي عـ system.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The technical diagnosis was accurate, identifying the line profile issue correctly after troubleshooting the local Wi-Fi.

evidence.text: بس ممكن تعطيني الـ account number لو سمحت عشان أشيك عـ system؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper procedure by asking for the account number before looking up the system details.

quote.speaker: Customer
